slot_scores.name: no_borrowing_cash_only
slot_scores.evidence_quote: At the beginning of Year 2, the cash available to invest equals the proceeds from product (1) invested in Year 1 plus any uninvested cash from Year 1 — is that correct, or are there other sources of cash at the beginning of Year 2?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about available cash sources and later modeled cash-only constraints, but did not explicitly ask whether borrowing or loans were allowed.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Borrowing is not allowed and investments must be funded only by initial capital and matured proceeds/cash carried forward.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never explicitly confirmed whether borrowing or loans were permitted; it only asked about cash sources and then assumed no borrowing in the final model.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL without fully resolving the P1 no-borrowing/cash-only constraint, which was only partially addressed.

summary: The agent asked many useful clarifying questions and built a coherent LP, but it only partially covered the no-borrowing/cash-only constraint and then silently assumed it in the final model.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
